title: Astral-plane text on the ESTIMATE providers (bedrock, anthropic, gemini)
why: The corpus had astral characters only on the `unicode` fixture, which is openai — the one provider counted EXACTLY. Every other provider is counted by the ~4-characters-per-token heuristic, and the two SDKs disagreed on what a 'character' is: Python's `len()` counts code points, JS's `text.length` counts UTF-16 code units, so every character outside the BMP counted double in JS. A Converse system block of `Répondez en français 🇫🇷` rendered 7 tokens in the JS SDK and 6 in Python — same trace, same content hash, different numbers in `ctxdiff tokens`, in the cache profiler's re-billed totals and in the dashboard's percentages. The goldens could not catch it because nothing in the corpus put an astral character in front of the estimator. This fixture does, on all three estimate providers and in every shape that reaches it: emoji, ZWJ sequences, regional-indicator and tag-sequence flags, skin-tone modifiers, math alphanumerics, CJK extension B/G, and astral text inside a tool schema's JSON. Blocks are deliberately sized so the divide, not the `max(1, …)` floor, decides the count.
